evidence.note: Leaf-first execution: builds and tests common (259/261) as a milestone, then a TodoWrite (264) transitions to storage, built at 333 — dependency-respecting order with concrete build/test done-checks per crate.

reasoning: The agent maintained an explicit, dependency-aware leaf-to-root plan with milestones tied to concrete checks (per-crate build then provided-test green), used TodoWrite to track sub-goals across a very long horizon, sequenced sub-modules within the largest crate via a verified pilot-then-fan-out pattern, and re-sequenced to the common foundation as dependencies were discovered — squarely matching the level-8 anchor. It stops short of 10 because api-server (a hardest crate) was a reactive compile-fix loop rather than a checkpointed sequence with explicit exit tests, and kubelet was delegated as a single undifferentiated block.
